pr_title: planner: donot prune all columns for Projection
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: guo-shaoge <shaoge1994@163.com>

<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #23887 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:  

```
Hash Join (eq("abc", tbl1.col1))
  |                     |
Projection     DataSource(tbl1)
  |
Index Join
```

1. We prune all columns in `Projection`
2. Resolve indices for `col1`, Its index is 0(because `Projection`'s output columns are all pruned)
3. `Projection` is eliminated, because its output columns are all pruned. But **Index Join** still has output columns
4. Got panic when calc `eq("abc", tbl1.col1)`. Because use index 0 to eval tbl1.col1

### What is changed and how it works?
What's Changed: 
1. We donot prune all columns in `Projection`. If `Projection` is pruned to empty, we make it a `Projection 1` (just like count(1))
2. Delete some code in `rule_eliminate_projection.go`, because Projection cannot be empty. Check [here](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/6318)


### Related changes

- PR to update `pingcap/docs`/`pingcap/docs-cn`:
- Need to cherry-pick to the release branch

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->


- Integration test


Side effects: no

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- donot prune all columns for Projection
pr_comments: As @lzmhhh123 suggested, I'm trying to make it `Projection(1)`, just like `Count(1)` does. Good for performance.
@winoros PTAL the PR. Do you have any better way to solve the issue?

> tryEliminateProjection

You mean we do not eliminate `Projection` whose output column is empty?

Maybe we can not do that because this [PR](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/6318)

> > > tryEliminateProjection
> > 
> > 
> > You mean we do not eliminate `Projection` whose output column is empty?
> > Maybe we can not do that because this [PR](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/6318)
> 
> No, we can check whether a join above it.

I think this bug is not only for Join, for example, `Apply` may also got same error.

    Apply
     |       |
    DS   Projection
             |
            xxx

You can repeat this bug use following SQL(I will add it to testcase): 

    drop table if exists t, s;
    create table t(a int, b int);
    insert into t values(1, 2), (3, 4);
    select (2) in (select b from t) from (select t.a < (select t.a from t t1 limit 1) from t) t;

Column index of `subquery_agg10000.z.col_char_64` in `HashJoin_17` is 0, it means when eval `col_char_64`, we will use first column in output chunk of `TableReader_55` as input. 

There should be zero column in output chunk of `TableReader_55`(because other cond in `HashJoin_17` doesn't use any row of `TableReader_55`). But actually there are 4 column in the output of `TableReader_55`.

So root cause of this panic is `HashJoin_19`'s output is wrong(MPP hash join).
